I am an old woman with no schooling, and this small plot of trees and enset has fed my family for many years without bought chemicals. My children and grandchildren help me weed and gather when they can, but we have no money to hire workers or buy sprays for just this quarter-gasha of land. We spread whatever cow dung and compost we have around the plants, as our parents taught us, but we do not carry factory fertilizer up here.
